mainline/zhizhulin#1.zh: 林冲获罪刺配沧州，董超、薛霸押着他行至野猪林，借口歇息，将他绑在树旁。
mainline/zhizhulin#1.t: Convicted and exiled to Cangzhou, Lin Chong was escorted by Dong Chao and Xue Ba to Wild Boar Forest. On the pretext of a rest, they tied him to a tree.

mainline/zhizhulin#2.zh: 林冲，到了这无人处，也该了结你的性命了！
mainline/zhizhulin#2.t: Lin Chong, now that we're somewhere nobody can see, it's time to end your life!

mainline/zhizhulin#3.zh: 董超、薛霸！你们受高俅指使，竟敢在押解途中害我！
mainline/zhizhulin#3.t: Dong Chao! Xue Ba! Gao Qiu put you up to this, and you dare murder me on the road!

mainline/zhizhulin#4.zh: 少说废话！今日便叫你死在这野猪林中！
mainline/zhizhulin#4.t: Enough talk! Today you die in Wild Boar Forest!

mainline/zhizhulin#5.zh: 眼见二人举起棍棒，林中忽然传来一声断喝！
mainline/zhizhulin#5.t: Just as the two raised their staves, a shout thundered from the woods!

mainline/zhizhulin#6.zh: 住手！有我在，休想伤林教头分毫！
mainline/zhizhulin#6.t: Stop! While I'm here, you won't touch a hair on Instructor Lin's head!

mainline/zhizhulin#7.zh: 洒家早料到这两个公人没安好心！林教头，洒家来救你！
mainline/zhizhulin#7.t: I knew these two guards were up to no good! Instructor Lin, I've come to save you!

mainline/zhizhulin#8.t: Brother Lu! Thank you for saving my life!

mainline/zhizhulin#9.zh: 先打发了这两个狗官，咱们再说话！
mainline/zhizhulin#9.t: First let's deal with these two dogs, then we'll talk!

mainline/zhizhulin#11.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打退董超、薛霸及林中强人和头目
mainline/zhizhulin#11.t: Victory --- Drive off Dong Chao, Xue Ba, and the forest bandits and their chief

mainline/zhizhulin#12.zh: 失败条件一 --- 主角死亡

mainline/zhizhulin#13.zh: 失败条件二 --- 林冲死亡

mainline/zhizhulin#14.zh: 失败条件三 --- 鲁智深死亡

mainline/zhizhulin#15.zh: 喊杀声四起，野猪林中又窜出数名强人！
mainline/zhizhulin#15.t: Shouts ring out on all sides as more bandits burst out of Wild Boar Forest!

mainline/zhizhulin#16.zh: 强人四散逃走，林中头目闻声赶来，拦住众人的去路。
mainline/zhizhulin#16.t: The bandits scatter, and their chief comes running at the noise to block the way.

mainline/zhizhulin#17.zh: 打了我的弟兄，还想从野猪林安然走出去？
mainline/zhizhulin#17.t: You beat my brothers and think you can walk out of Wild Boar Forest in one piece?

mainline/zhizhulin#18.zh: 董超、薛霸伏法，林中强人也被打退。众人不敢久留，继续暗中护送林冲前往沧州。
mainline/zhizhulin#18.t: Dong Chao and Xue Ba were dealt with, and the forest bandits driven off. Not daring to linger, the group went on secretly escorting Lin Chong toward Cangzhou.

mainline/zhizhulin#19.t: Lin Chong saved in Wild Boar Forest!

mainline/zhizhulin#20.zh: 主角倒在野猪林中，林冲与鲁智深被强人围住，终究未能脱身……
mainline/zhizhulin#20.t: The hero fell in Wild Boar Forest. Lin Chong and Lu Zhishen were surrounded by bandits and could not escape...

mainline/zhizhulin#21.zh: 林冲死于押解途中，鲁智深与主角悲愤难当，却被官差和强人团团围住……
mainline/zhizhulin#21.t: Lin Chong died on the road into exile. Lu Zhishen and the hero, mad with grief, were surrounded by guards and bandits...

mainline/zhizhulin#22.zh: 鲁智深倒在野猪林中，林冲与主角再难抵挡官差和强人……
mainline/zhizhulin#22.t: Lu Zhishen fell in Wild Boar Forest. Lin Chong and the hero could no longer hold off the guards and bandits...
